args: Is the ~1.08 adjustments-per-variant ratio apparel-specific or company-wide?

Is the near-constant rate of about 1.08 routine stock-adjustments per distinct affected variant per year a quirk of the apparel/footwear vertical, or does it hold across all merchant verticals — i.e., is the whole routine discrepancy stream essentially a flat background rate of roughly one single-unit miss per SKU per year, regardless of product type?
